description: Universal schema for extracting design + conversion patterns from ANY ranked website

hero_section.emotional_appeal: string: primary emotion (empathy, authority, curiosity, urgency)
hero_section.barrier_removal_priority: array: [barrier1, barrier2, barrier3] ordered by what converts
hero_section.conversion_signal: string: what CTA text + color + placement converts
hero_section.headline_structure: string: describe headline construction (question, statement, permission, etc.)

tone_and_language.key_phrases: array: phrases that appear on all winners

social_proof.types_used: array: [testimonials, logos, stats, case_studies, reviews, credentials, outcomes]
social_proof.effectiveness_ranking: array: what type converts most to least for this vertical
social_proof.diversity_signals: string: what diversity is shown (demographics, use cases, industries)
social_proof.outcome_quantification: string: how outcomes are stated (percentage, absolute, relative)

visual_hierarchy.psychology_notes: string: why these colors work for this vertical

conversion_mechanics.cta_texts: array: actual button/link text that converts
conversion_mechanics.friction_removal_techniques: array: how they make the ask easy
conversion_mechanics.what_fails_if_removed: array: core elements that kill conversion if absent

stage_indicators.trust_buildup_sequence: string: in what order do they establish trust (early, middle, late)
stage_indicators.proof_points_by_stage: object: {early: [], mid: [], late: []} what proves what when

vertical_specific_patterns.description: any patterns unique to this vertical (e.g., credentialing for therapy, ROI for B2B)

source_metadata.ranking_signal: string: why it ranks (top for 'keyword', trending, etc.)
source_metadata.patterns_extracted_from: array: which sections (hero, about, pricing, social_proof, etc.)
